mapper.select: SELECT id, name, species, breed, gender, birth_date AS birthDate, height, neck_size AS neckSize, chest_size AS chestSize, body_height AS bodyHeight, neutered, activity_level AS activityLevel, memo FROM pets ORDER BY id

SELECT id, name, species, breed, gender, birth_date AS birthDate, height, neck_size AS neckSize, chest_size AS chestSize, body_height AS bodyHeight, neutered, activity_level AS activityLevel, memo FROM pets WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO pets ( name, species, breed, gender, birth_date, height, neck_size, chest_size, body_height, neutered, activity_level, memo ) VALUES ( #{name}, #{species}, #{breed}, #{gender}, #{birthDate}, #{height}, #{neckSize}, #{chestSize}, #{bodyHeight}, #{neutered}, #{activityLevel}, #{memo} )
mapper.update: UPDATE pets SET name = #{name}, species = #{species}, breed = #{breed}, gender = #{gender}, birth_date = #{birthDate}, height = #{height}, neck_size = #{neckSize}, chest_size = #{chestSize}, body_height = #{bodyHeight}, neutered = #{neutered}, activity_level = #{activityLevel}, memo = #{memo} WHERE id = #{id}
